Namespace OnixRuntime.Api.Events.Session

Classes

ChatMessageAddedEventData

Represents the chat message that will be added if ShouldSilence is false. This is basically the same as the on chat event, just as a class.

CommandResponseMessage

Represents a message in a command's response.

ModalFormAny

Represents a modal form of any type.

ModalFormCustom

Represents a customizable modal form consisting of a title and input elements the user can change and submit.

ModalFormCustom.Dropdown

A dropdown element with some entries to select from.

ModalFormCustom.FormElement

The base form element type.

ModalFormCustom.Input

A textbox element where the user can enter text.

ModalFormCustom.Label

Represents a label element that can display text to the user.

ModalFormCustom.Slider

Represents a slider the user can slide around a range with a step.

ModalFormCustom.StepSlider

Represents a slider that can be dragged across named elements, like a dropdown but in slider format.

ModalFormCustom.Toggle

Represents a true/false toggle element.

ModalFormCustomReplier

Replier for custom-type forms (forms with interactive elements). Values are stored internally — the original form elements are never mutated. Pre-populated with each element's default so unset fields still produce a valid response.

ModalFormForm

Represents a form that has many choices of buttons to click with an optional image.

ModalFormForm.Button

Represents one of the buttons that the user can click.

ModalFormForm.Button.ButtonImage

The base image type that a button can have.

ModalFormForm.Button.ImageFromPack

A button image that contains a path in the resource pack.

ModalFormForm.Button.ImageFromUrl

A button image that contains a url.

ModalFormFormReplier

Replier for form-type forms (button list).

ModalFormInvalid

Represents an invalid form, one that failed parsing. You should maybe report this as a bug if the form is supposed to be valid.

ModalFormModal

Represents a modal form with two buttons, a title and some text. Mainly useful for yes/no questions.

ModalFormModalReplier

Replier for modal-type forms (two-button dialog), allowing you to safely reply to it.

ModalFormReplierAny

Abstract base class for all modal form repliers. Allowing you to reply to forms safely. HasBeenRepliedAlready is only set to true when FormEvent_ReplyToModalForm is actually called.

OnixEventSessionChat

Provides events for chat message receiving, sending, and command sending in a session.

OnixEventSessionModalForms

Provides events for modal form requests and responses in a session.

OnixEventSessionPluginMessageConnection

Events plugin messages the server sends to your client.

OnixEventSessionTitle

Provides events for handling title, subtitle, actionbar, and timing changes in a session.

RawModalFormReplier

Implements ModalFormReplierAny for raw JSON modal form events.

VanillaCommandResponse

Represents a vanilla command response, but all in one struct.

Interfaces

IModalFormReplier

Represents a Replier for modal form events, providing form ID, response JSON, and reply status.

GameTitleType

Delegate for handling chat command received events. Note that this might not be received if the server uses TextPacket for its responses or sends a different id. This will also not work when 'sendcommandfeedback' is disabled.
